target.title: docs(irc): document missing markdown, chunkMode, and responsePrefix fields
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`extensions/irc/src/config-schema.ts` includes `markdown` (MarkdownConfigSchema) and spreads `ReplyRuntimeConfigSchemaShape` which provides `chunkMode` and `responsePrefix`, but `docs/channels/irc.md` does not document these reply-formatting fields. Users configuring IRC cannot discover these formatting options from the docs.

- Problem: Three reply-formatting fields exist in the IRC config schema/types but are absent from the docs
- Solution: Add a "Message formatting" section documenting `markdown`, `chunkMode`, and `responsePrefix`
- What changed: `docs/channels/irc.md` (+7 lines — new H2 section with 3 field descriptions)
- What did NOT change: No code or behavior changes. Documentation only.

**Missing fields**:
1. **`markdown`** (MarkdownConfigSchema) — table rendering: `tables: "native" | "ascii" | "simple"`
2. **`chunkMode`** (`"length" | "newline"`) — message splitting strategy, default `"length"`
3. **`responsePrefix`** (string) — prepended to every outbound reply

## Evidence

### Schema — `markdown` field (`extensions/irc/src/config-schema.ts:67`)

```typescript
markdown: MarkdownConfigSchema,
```

### Schema — `chunkMode` + `responsePrefix` via spread (`extensions/irc/src/config-schema.ts:68`)

```typescript
...ReplyRuntimeConfigSchemaShape,
```

### Core schema — `ReplyRuntimeConfigSchemaShape` (`src/config/zod-schema.core.ts:649-660`)

```typescript
export const ReplyRuntimeConfigSchemaShape = {
  // ...
  chunkMode: z.enum(["length", "newline"]).optional(),
  responsePrefix: z.string().optional(),
  // ...
};
```

### Core schema — `MarkdownConfigSchema` (`src/config/zod-schema.core.ts`)

```typescript
export const MarkdownConfigSchema = z
  .object({
    tables: MarkdownTableModeSchema.optional(),  // "native" | "ascii" | "simple"
  })
  .strict()
  .optional();
```

### Runtime types (`extensions/irc/src/types.ts:61-66`)

```typescript
markdown?: MarkdownConfig;
chunkMode?: "length" | "newline";
responsePrefix?: string;
```

## User Impact

Users can now discover three reply-formatting options from the IRC channel docs: Markdown table rendering, message chunking strategy, and reply prefix. All three were already functional — they were simply invisible to users who configure via docs.
